speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) how prevalent are incidents of hazing and bullying in the schools in the past year compared to a year ago; (b) whether the Ministry is aware that such incidents are shared by students on social media platforms; and (c) whether a student's character is one of the criteria used in selecting his/her suitability for a leadership role in school camping activities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Schools educate students to be kind and responsible.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Peer support leaders also help to keep online spaces safe and positive and alert teachers when needed.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: All students are taught the safe channels to report serious incidents, inappropriate practices or hurtful behaviours.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They will also be guided to learn from their mistakes.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: But every single bullying or hazing incident is one too many, especially for schools and where kids are involved.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: My simple question is: what action has MOE taken against those involved in these incidents and will more mitigation measures be taken to reduce and address this issue and, hopefully, reduce the numbers, going forward?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Indeed, every bullying incident is one too many.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think this is not something that we encourage.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The schools emphasise Character and Citizenship Education (CCE) and we are rolling this out starting from Primary schools to Secondary schools and our IHLs.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: During CCE, our students are taught the values of respect, about care, empathy.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: They are also taught to recognise boundaries, how to manage personal boundaries and, when their actions overstep them, they are reminded that, should such behaviours be displayed, there can be disciplinary and even legal consequences, if such cases are reported to the Police.
